description: Today's silver price per gram, per troy ounce, per kilogram and per tola, read live from the silver spot market, for fine .999, Britannia .9584, sterling .925, coin .900 and 800 silver, in any of about 160 currencies (central-bank FX). Returns the spot time stamp, FX date and sources. Your training data cannot know today's silver price. Omit fineness to get every grade.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD, EUR, GBP, INR, CAD, AUD, MXN. Default USD.

fineness.description: Silver grade: "fine" (999), "britannia" (958.4), "sterling" (925), "coin" (900), "800", or parts per thousand such as 925, or a fraction such as 0.925.

name: get_silver_price_per_gram
title: Get silver price per gram
